title: In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.1.3, 2025.11.7 stored XSS on the Disk Usage and Build Time pages was possible…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in JetBrains TeamCity versions before 2026.1.3 and 2025.11.7 on the Disk Usage and Build Time pages. This vulnerability allows an attacker with high privileges to inject malicious scripts that can execute in the context of other users. The flaw has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 8.1.
